status: COMPLETE: 5000/5000 pairs answered for both robots; nothing running

pairs.rule: uniform over the box, d_xy >= 3 m, both endpoints gs3d-oracle free (margin 0.001) for BOTH robots at each robot's own z_c; one shared list; no connectivity filter
pairs.why_uniform: the planner's certified UNREACHABLE is a result in itself; a reachability witness would filter out exactly the lamp-crossing pairs that show it. UNREACHABLE/UNKNOWN rates are reported as they fall.
pairs.why_shared: paired sweeper-vs-cylinder comparison on every pair; the cylinder's free set is contained in the sweeper's (G1 map), so this equals the cylinder's own endpoint set; for the sweeper it excludes the sweeper-only lamp zone/pockets as ENDPOINTS (still crossable mid-route)

compile.policy: persist and reload: ONE compile per robot for all 5000 pairs = G1's demo compile (jobs 18704511/18704512 at cd18230; gmc/src and the runner unchanged since, so byte-identical to a G2 recompile). G2 ran zero compiles.

a3c.sweeper: gmc/outputs/aerial3dg/demo/sweeper.a3c (180 MB, not committed; sidecar sha256 in results/aerial3dg/g1/runs/demo/sweeper.a3c.json)
a3c.cylinder: gmc/outputs/aerial3dg/demo/cylinder.a3c (387 MB, not committed; sidecar in results/aerial3dg/g1/runs/demo/cylinder.a3c.json)

compile.proof_per_task: each task summary's compile_once_proof: compiles_in_this_process 0 (counter wrapped around gmc.aerial3d.api.compile_complex), loads_in_this_process 1 (SHA-256 checked), compile records unchanged by queries, one compile_id on every row, no compile stage inside any query call -- true for all 20 tasks

run.raw_per_pair_jsonl: gmc/results/aerial3dg/g2/runs/{sweeper,cylinder}/task_{00..09}.jsonl (one JSON line per pair: status, reason, route_polyline in route frame, path length, clearance, query stages, cut attribution by manifest role)

paired.definition: key = 'sweeper status|cylinder status' on the same pair

wall_clock.note: sample 3.6 min, then both robots' arrays in parallel; the cylinder's 5000 finished in ~8 min, the sweeper's in ~30 min (up to 5 concurrent tasks)

vs_g1_estimate.why: sweeper 2.6x over central (mean 1.12 s/pair vs 0.44): G1's screen pairs were short (median 3.57 m) and bucketed toward near-straight 'thread'/'lamp' routes; uniform pairs have median 5.3 m and more corners (4.6 vs 2.9 route vertices); shortcut+tighten = 0.99 s of the 1.16 s REACHABLE mean (0.37 in G1's screen) and grow with route length/complexity. Cylinder 0.44x of central (0.105 s/pair vs 0.26): 98.5% of uniform pairs are cheap certified cuts (0.035 s) or UNKNOWN (0.15 s). Total within G1's p95 bound (5.3 CPU-h), just above its pessimistic column (1.55).

interpretation_for_g3.contrast: 2783 pairs: sweeper REACHABLE (threads under the lamp) while the cylinder is certified UNREACHABLE (possible-space cut); every cylinder UNREACHABLE crosses the lamp at u~-0.85. 1843 pairs: sweeper REACHABLE, cylinder UNKNOWN across the u~-5.6 structure (sweeper uses the v 1.8-1.9 gap). 73 pairs both REACHABLE (cylinder detour ratio mean 1.052 vs sweeper 1.032 overall).
